channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: US Treasury Bars Reporters From Several Outlets From G20 Meeting
item.description: The US Treasury Department excluded journalists from several media outlets, including Bloomberg News and the Wall Street Journal, from coverage of this week’s Group of 20 finance ministers summit in Asheville, North Carolina, amid global market volatility and the US-Iran conflict.

item.title: US strikes Iranian rocket launchers near Strait of Hormuz after month-long pause in attacks; Tehran warns of response
item.description: Iranian semiofficial media reported explosions near Larak Island, located in the Strait of Hormuz. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps acknowledged that several of its fighters and other people had been killed or wounded.

item.title: Quote of the day by Elizabeth Olsen: ‘I believe that you are only in control of so much. So whatever…’
item.description: Elizabeth Olsen's reflection on accepting what lies beyond our control offers a simple reminder about letting go, a mindset that has also shaped her approach to fame, acting, and life beyond the spotlight.&nbsp;

item.title: California student rejected by 16 of 18 colleges despite 1590 SAT gets court’s approval to pursue bias claims
item.description: Nan Zhong and his son, Stanley Zhong, have filed lawsuits against several prominent universities, including the University of Washington, the University of California system, the University of Michigan and Cornell University.

item.title: World News Today Live Updates on August 31, 2026 : Ferry carrying 267 sinks off Northern Cyprus; 8 dead, 17 missing; Captain and 7 crew arrested
item.description: World News Today Live Updates on August 31, 2026: Stay informed on global events with our in-depth world news coverage, bringing you the latest developments across politics, economy, and culture. Discover insights into international affairs, breaking news, and the trends shaping our interconnected world, all in one place.

item.title: Ferry carrying 267 sinks off Northern Cyprus; 8 dead, 17 missing; Captain and 7 crew arrested
item.description: The privately operated FILOJET ferry was travelling from Kyrenia to the Turkish port of Tasucu in the eastern Mediterranean when it began taking on water shortly after leaving port.

item.title: Zomato listed cloud kitchen goes viral for 'GLP-1 friendly and high protein'- We checked their menu
item.description: A Zomato cloud kitchen’s ‘GLP-1 friendly’ menu has sparked debate over whether specialised meals help people taking weight-loss medication or turn a medical treatment into another diet trend.

item.title: Trump targets NBC host Kristen Welker, demands FCC action over her ‘mixed results’ assessment of his endorsements
item.description: In a series of posts on Truth Social, Trump attacked Welker after she said his endorsements had produced “mixed results.” Trump rejected the assessment, claiming his endorsements had succeeded “98 percent to 100 percent of the time.”

item.title: Bengaluru CEO won $500 hackathon prize at 15, turned down US college offer, now runs $50 million startup
item.description: Meet Naman Pushp, the 21-year-old founder and CEO of Airbound, focusing on drone delivery. It has reportedly completed more than 13,000 autonomous flights across Bengaluru and the Guntur region.&nbsp;

item.title: 'Banque Misr to continue business as usual': UAE, Egypt central banks issue joint statement after US action
item.description: UAE and Egypt central banks affirmed coordination over Banque Misr's UAE branches after US action targeting their dollar transactions. They said the branches would take necessary measures to ensure Banque Misr continues its business as usual.

item.title: ₹47,000 in India vs ₹22 lakh in US: Man says on Instagram he’s changing countries over healthcare
item.description: User Yuvaan Ibañez Garware on Instagram, spent 16 years in Pune, India. While his mom is Indian, his father is Colombian. Here's what he said about the healthcare facility in the country.

item.title: Nepal floods: Bus carrying rescued survivors crashes, 32 injured; death toll nears 800
item.description: Nepal’s flood death toll nears 800 as a bus carrying rescued survivors crashes, injuring 32. Thousands remain missing as rescue teams battle rising river levels.

item.title: Trump to use Venezuelan oil to refill US petroleum reserve; details of deal remain unclear
item.description: Trump said the deal would give the US a stake in Venezuela's vast oil reserves and help revive the country's battered energy industry. The agreement follows the US capture of former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in January. Maduro was taken to New York to face federal drug-trafficking charges.

item.title: Lake Ontario is now ‘Lake America’ on Google Maps for US users after Trump’s renaming order
item.description: Google has begun displaying Lake Ontario as Lake America for users in the US, following President Donald Trump's executive order, while Canada will retain the original name.

item.title: Beer heist? 17,964 litres of alcohol valued at ₹66.76 lakh stolen in California, brand says ‘not a marketing stunt’
item.description: The Montclair Police Department is currently investigating the case who added the incidents could be part of two cargo thefts in August. No suspects have been identified.

item.title: WhatsApp group with 532 members, 82,000 messages, millions in cash transfers: Report exposes hawala network
item.description: The 532-member group, called “Traders of Greater Europe,” reportedly contained more than 82,000 messages exchanged between February and December 2022. The messages were used to arrange cash transfers across borders, including payments involving British cities such as London and Birmingham.

item.title: India, Uzbekistan target $5 billion trade by 2030, move to cut barriers
item.description: Bilateral trade stood at $1.3 billion in 2025 as the two sides seek to expand market access, investment and cooperation in critical minerals

item.title: Nepal floods: 149 Indians rescued amid evacuation efforts, MEA releases names
item.description: India and China have joined intensified rescue and relief operations in flood-hit Nepal, where devastating flash floods along the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river corridors have left workers trapped inside tunnels at hydropower projects.

item.title: At Least Seven People Die in Northern Cyprus Ferry Capsizing
item.description: At least seven people died after a ferry carrying about 267 capsized while sailing from Kyrenia in northern Cyprus to Tasucu in southern Turkey, the Anadolu news agency reported, citing Turkish Cypriot Prime Minister Unal Ustel.

item.title: Who is Divya Mittal? Why did IAS officer announce resignation on X after 13 years in civil services? What we know
item.description: Divya Mittal, the 2013-batch officer, served as district magistrate in three districts of Uttar Pradesh. She was posted as special secretary at the state government's Revenue Department.

item.title: ICE Deports Right-Wing Provocateur, Influencer Milo Yiannopoulos
item.description: Federal immigration authorities said they deported right-wing provocateur and online influencer Milo Yiannopoulos after he was detained and accused of overstaying his visa.

item.title: Fertilizer management gets a digital overhaul for end-to-end tracking, subsidy targeting
item.description: The government is bringing farmer, land and crop data into its fertilizer tracking system, using data analytics for closer end-to-end monitoring. The move aims to spot supply gaps and any unusual purchases to better target fertilizer subsidies. &nbsp;&nbsp;

item.title: Miami man drops out of business college to sell Pokémon cards, clocks ₹74.4 crore sales
item.description: A man shared his entrepreneurial journey, going from earning $10 an hour at a croqueta bar to generating $7.8 million in sales in a year. He found his true calling through his love for Pokémon cards.

item.title: Bombay HC pulls up Maharashtra FDA over enforcement actions: What businesses need to know
item.description: The Bombay High Court has scrutinised Maharashtra FDA's enforcement actions against businesses, including Cipla, restaurants, hotels and dairies, questioning due process and proportionality while allowing relief in several cases.

item.title: India met FY26 fiscal consolidation target, says Sitharaman in the US
item.description: Speaking to members of the Indian diaspora in Chicago during her official visit to the US, India's finance minister, Nirmala Sitharaman, said the government had set a target of reducing borrowing to 50% of GDP by 2030.

item.title: From crude exporter to fuel importer: How Russia turned to India amid Ukrainian attacks on its refineries
item.description: Russia, one of the world's major crude exporters, has turned to gasoline imports after Ukrainian drone attacks disrupted its refineries. India has emerged as a key supplier, shipping nearly 1 million barrels of gasoline to Russia over the past two months.

item.title: Women account for 46% of street vendor credit scheme beneficiaries, says PM Modi
item.description: The PM also called upon citizens to support the government's campaign to protect the youth from drug addiction.

item.title: Beyond loneliness: Keralam’s ambitious bet on ‘aging in place’ and the silver economy
item.description: As youth migrate and palatial homes stand silent, Keralam is crafting a new blueprint for elderly care. From vibrant daycare centres to innovative ‘time banks’, explore how the rapidly ageing state is transforming loneliness into companionship.

item.title: India sets first national standards for mortuaries, bans basement morgues
item.description: The new rules set minimum requirements for cold storage, staffing, body identification and autopsy facilities, seeking to standardize India’s fragmented mortuary infrastructure.

item.title: 'Fishing, sovereignty and economic policy': Why Iceland voters rejected EU membership in referendum
item.description: Icelandic voters rejected a proposal to resume EU membership talks, with 52.8% voting against. Fishing concerns, sovereignty and economic policy shaped the referendum, while the result is expected to put the EU membership debate on hold until at least 2028.

item.title: Who is Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal? President Murmu’s ex-ADC dubbed the ‘national crush’ who took premature retirement
item.description: Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal, an internet sensation and former ADC to President Droupadi Murmu, has retired from the Indian Army after 12 years of service

item.title: PM Modi conferred with Uzbekistan’s ‘Oliy Darajali Do'stlik’ Order by President Mirziyoyev
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with the Order of ‘Oliy Darajali Dustlik’, Uzbekistan’s supreme state award, by President Shavkat Mirziyoyev during his visit to Tashkent. The honour marks Modi’s 36th international award.

item.title: ‘My overtime is invisible’: Worker penalised for 15-minute delay, ordeal with strict HR goes viral
item.description: In the viral post, the employee said that he joined an event management company in May, which has official working hours of 11 AM to 7 PM with weekends off — but the reality painted a very different picture.

item.title: Drone Sparks Russia Refinery Fire as Moscow Warns of Retaliation
item.description: A Ukrainian drone hit caused a fire at an oil refinery in Kirishi, near Russia’s Baltic Sea coast, weeks after the facility was preparing to resume operations following months of repairs following earlier strikes.

item.title: IAS officer who left finance job in London for civil services resigns after 13 years, recalls ‘unforgettable journey’
item.description: Divya Mittal, an IAS officer, resigned after serving as a civil servant for 13 years. After impactful service in various administrative roles in Uttar Pradesh, she cherished memories from her tenure.
